# 百法明門論纂

**ID:** X0803
**Volume:** X48
**Category:** 瑜伽部類
**Original Category:** 大小乘釋論部／百法並百法明門論疏
**Byline:** 明 廣益纂釋
**Dynasty:** 明
**Date:** 1368–1644
**Juans:** 1
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/X0803

## Contributors
- 廣益 (A001661)

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-fascicle late-Míng introductory commentary on Vasubandhu's [KR6n0096](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0096) *Dàshèng bǎifǎ míngmén lùn* 大乘百法明門論 (T31n1614, in [玄奘](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%8E%84%E5%A5%98)'s translation), compiled by [廣益](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%BB%A3%E7%9B%8A) Xūzhōng Guǎngyì on the explicit instruction of his teacher [德清](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%BE%B7%E6%B8%85) Hānshān Déqīng (1546–1623). Preserved in the *Manji Xuzangjing* 卍續藏 at X48n0803. Hānshān himself supplied the framing prefatory note and personally vetted the manuscript ("天啟壬戌夏日 七十七翁憨山老人手批" — Hānshān's own annotation, dated summer of *tiānqǐ rénxū* = 1622, when Hānshān was seventy-seven *suì*).

**Abstract**

The *Zuǎn* presents the *Bǎifǎ míngmén lùn* as the first reading in a structured Yogācāra curriculum, with three layers of commentary fused into a single running text: (a) Vasubandhu's root verses; (b) [窺基](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AA%BA%E5%9F%BA)'s and the standard Cí'ēn *shūyì* 疏義 expositions; (c) Guǎngyì's own bridging glosses that supply the *Yújiā* parent material. Where the existing *shūyì* tradition is silent, Guǎngyì draws on the *Zhíjiě* 直解 tradition and on his teacher's notes ("取(予)補義云"). The catalog meta confusingly tags the dynasty as 明 but lists no dates; on the basis of Hānshān's *tiānqǐ rénxū* (1622) endorsement and the master's death in 1623, the work itself was composed around 1622, with publication in or shortly after that year.

The *Zuǎn* is the standard late-Míng beginner's primer on the *Bǎifǎ míngmén lùn* and was widely used as the entry text into Yogācāra study by Hānshān's lineage. It is paired with Guǎngyì's *Bā shí guījǔ zuǎnshì* ([KR6n0136](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0136)) as a two-volume introductory set covering the two basic Yogācāra didactic texts.
